tgt: Rre Sandile Psychology Mkhize o thapilwe go nna Mokaedikhuduthamagamogolo wa Magalies Water (Nako ya konteraka eno e atolositswe).

src: Die Wetsontwerp gee uitvoering aan die Witskrif oor Huwelike in Suid-Afrika, wat in Maart 2022 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is.
tgt: Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa go Tswa mo Lenyalong wa Ngwaga wa 2023 Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng sekwalwa se iseng se butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa go Tswa mo Lenyalong wa Ngwaga wa 2023.

src: Die Wetsontwerp bemagtig die Departement van Binnelandse Sake om 'n enkele Huwelikswet vir die land te ontwikkel.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o kwalola sešwa Molao wa go Tswa mo Lenyalong wa ngwaga wa 1979 (Molao wa bo 70 wa 1979) mme seno ke go tla ka mekgwa ya go disa gore ditshwanelo tsa bana ba batsadi ba bona ba nyalaneng ka Semoselema ga di gatakiwe.

src: Die Konsepwetsontwerp poog om te verseker dat alle huwelike in ooreenstemming met die beginsels van gelykheid, niediskriminasie en menswaardigheid gesluit word, soos voorsien in die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996.
tgt: Maitlhomo a dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa tseno gape ke go thusa go kaela ka ditsela tse di ka dirisiwang go arogana dithoto fa go tswiwa mo lenyalong la Semoselema go tla ka melao ya go fedisa maatla a banna a go thopa dithoto fa ba tswa mo lenyalong la Semoselema.

src: Die Konsepwetsontwerp laat Suid-Afrikaners en inwoners van die land van alle seksuele oriëntasies, sowel as godsdienstige en kulturele oortuigings, toe om wettige verbintenisse in ooreenstemming met die grondwetlike beginsels te sluit.
tgt: Ka Seetebosigo 2022, Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo e rebotse katlholo ya gore Molao wa go Tswa mo Lenyalong yo o leng teng ga o tsamaisane le Molaotheo gonne ka mokgwa yo o kwadilweng ga o a akaretsa manyalo a Semoselema.

src: Die wetsontwerp beskryf maatreëls om verbintenisse soos kinderhuwelike en dié wat in die afwesigheid van die ander party gedoen word te voorkom.
tgt: Kgotlatshekelo eno e rebotse gape le gore Molao wa go Tswa mo Lenyalong ga o tsamaelane le Molaotheo gonne o na le kgethololo jaaka o kgetholola bana ba batsadi ba ba nyalaneng le bana ba batsadi ba ba sa nyalanang.

src: Die Wetsontwerp stel die oprigting van 'n NWHIA voor om verantwoordelik te wees vir die beplanning, finansiering en ontwikkeling van die land se waterinfrastruktuur.
tgt: Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Letlole la Tirisano le Dinaga tsa Boditšhabatšhaba go Tsosolosa Aforika (ARF) Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go phasalatsa sekwalwa se iseng se butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o kwalolotsweng sešwa wa ARF gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.

src: Dit sal opgestel word as 'n Openbare Entiteit kragtens Bylae 2 van die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur, 1999 (Wet 1 van 1999).
tgt: Maitlhomo a Molaotlhomo ono ke go kwalola sešwa Molao wa ARF (Molao wa bo 51 wa 2000).

src: Die agentskap sal die funksies oorneem wat tans deur die Trans-Caledon-Tonnelowerheid verrig word.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa tseno di raya gore jaanong ARF e tla bediwa Setheo sa Tirisanommogo le Tlhabololo ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Die ARF is van kritieke belang om Suid-Afrika se nasionale belange en waardes, die Afrika Renaissance en die skep van 'n beter wêreld vir almal te bevorder.
tgt: Naga ya Aforika Borwa e tla bua ka dintlha di le dintsinyana tse di farologaneng tse di jaaka go fetolwa ga ditheo tsa matlole a tlhabologo, mathata a dikoloto, ditsela tse dintšhwa tsa tlamelo ya matlole, makgetho a boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le ditshwanelo tse di itlhophileng tse di ka ga go ikgogela morago.

src: Gedurende die maand vier Suid-Afrikaners oudpresident Nelson Mandela se lewe en sy nalatenskap ons tree saam op om ons gemeenskappe te help om ten goede te verander en om pogings te integreer wat bydra tot die stryd teen armoede en ongelykheid.2 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die maand te gebruik om iets te doen wat 'n verskil in hul gemeenskappe sal maak en te verseker dat ons die Suid-Afrika bou wat ons stigtersvader in die vooruitsig gestel het.
tgt: Jaaka jaanong go setse matsatsi a le 36 fela gore Metshameko ya Kgaisanelo ya Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Bolotloa sa Ngwaga wa 2023 e simolole kwa Cape Town International Convention Centre go tloga ka la bo 28 Phukwi go fitlha ka la bo 06 Phatwe 2023, Kabinete e lebogile maAforika Borwa otlhe ka Botho jwa bona ka go amogela ka diatla tse di mofutho baromiwa ba ba tlileng go okomela maemo ka fa nageng ka bophara mo leetong la Meshameko ya Sejana sa Lefatshe.

src: Die toer het in KwaZulu-Natal afgeskop en sal na Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, Noordwes, die Vrystaat, die Noord-Kaap en die Oos-Kaap reis.
tgt: Leeto leno le simolotse pele kwa porofenseng ya kwa KwaZulu-Natal mme le tla re go tswa koo la leba mo porofenseng ya Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, Bokone Bophirima, Foreistata, Kapa Bokone mmogo le kwa Kapa Botlhaba.

src: Die toer bereik sy hoogtepunt in die Wes-Kaap as die gasheerprovinsie, voor die toernooi op 28 Julie 2023 begin.5 Banyana Banyana vertrek na FIFA-Vrouewêreldbeker.1 Namens die nasie dra die Kabinet sy beste wense oor aan die nasionale vrouesokkerspan, Banyana Banyana, wat op Vrydag 23 Junie vertrek na die FIFA Wêreldbeker vir vroue, wat in Julie in Australië en Nieu-Seeland aangebied word.2 Die span se prestasies in verskeie toernooie het wêreldwyd die aandag gevestig op die ontwikkeling van vrouesokker in Suid-Afrika, as deel van die breër selfbemagtiging en maatskaplike bemagtiging van vroue in die land.
tgt: Leeto leno le tla garelwa kwa Kapa Bophirima jaaka e le yona porofense e metshameko e tla bong e tshamekelwa kwa go yona, mme leeto leno le tla garelwa pele metshameko eno e simolola ka la bo 28 Phukwi Setlhopha sa Banyana Banyana se tla Leba kwa Sejaneng sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Kgwele ya Dinao ya Basadi ya FIFKabinete, mo legatong la baagi ba naga, e eletsa masego setlhopha sa naga sa kgwele ya dinao ya basadi sa Banyana Banyana, jaaka ba ipaakanyetsa go leba kwa Sejaneng sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Kgwele ya Dinao ya Basadi ya FIFA ka la bo 23 Seetebosigo 2023, mme metshameko eno e tla tshamekelwa kwa nageng ya Australia le ya New Zealand mo kgweding ya Phukwi.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet dra wense van geluk en voorspoed oor aan: Suid-Afrikaanse rolstoeltennisspelers Donald Ramphadi en Kgothatso Montjane, wat as Grand Slam-kampioene in hul onderskeie afdelings by die gesogte Roland Garros-toernooi in Frankryk uit die stryd getree WEBTOKEN die wenners van die 2023-Comrades Marathon, asook al die deelnemers aan dié ultramarathon vanaf Pietermaritzburg na Durban.
tgt: Melaetsa ya go AkgolaKabinete e romela melaetsa ya yona ya go akgola le go eletsa masego kwa go: Batshameki ba metshameko ya tenese ya batho ba ba dirisang ditulo tsa batho ba ba retelelwang ke go tsamaya ka maoto a bona e bong Donald Ramphadi le Kgothatso Montjane ba ba tlhageletseng jaaka dinaledi mo metshamekong e ba neng ba tshameka mo go yona kwa dikgaisanong tse di tlotlomadiwang tsa Roland Garros kwa nageng ya Fora.

src: Ons wens Tete Dijana en Gerda Steyn geluk met hul prestasies hulle het nie net die mans- en vrouewedloop gewen nie, maar het onderskeidelik ook die af-wedlooprekords vir die mans- en vrouewedloop verbeter.
tgt: Botlhe ba ba fentseng Lebelo la metabogo la ngwaga wa 2023 la Comrade Marathon mmogo le bao ba nnileng le seabe mo lebelong le le potlana la go tloga kwa Pietermaritzburg go leba kwa Durban.

src: Spesiale melding word ook gemaak van Ntate Johannes Mosehla van Limpopo, wat op die ouderdom van 81 die oudste persoon is wat die Comrades voltooi het.
tgt: Re akgola Tete Dijana mmogo le Gerda Steyn ka go latelana ga bona mo mabelong a bona e leng lebelo la banna le la basadi, mme ga re ba akgolele fela gore ke bafenyi, re ba akgolela gape le gore bobedi jwa bona bo fetile direkoto tse di sa bolong go nna teng tsa bafenyi ba mo WEBTOKEN tlhoka gape le go akgola Rre wa kwa porofenseng ya Limpopo e bong Rre Johannes Mosehla yo, le fa a na le dingwaga di le 81, a lwetseng gore a konosetse lebelo la gagwe mo lebelong la di-comrade.

src: In Jeugmaand kan Suid-Afrikaners van alle ouderdomme die waarde en voordeel van 'n gesonde leefstyl by hierdie baie senior burger leer.
tgt: Mo Kgweding eno ya Bašwa, MaAforika Borwa go sa kgathalesege gore ke ba dingwaga dife ba ka itseela botlhale go tswa mo moaging yono le go iponela merokotso ya go tshela ka go itlhokomela.

src: Die Kabinet bring ook hulde aan Nomhle Ngwenya, wat die jongste en eerste swart vrou is wat 'n doktorsgraad aan Wits-universiteit se Fakulteit Natuurwetenskap behaal het op die ouderdom van net WEBTOKEN P Khoza, wat verkies is as die president van die 42e ICAO-vergadering wat van 27 September tot 7 Oktober 2022 in Montreal, Kanada plaasgevind het.
tgt: Kabinete e batla gape le go akgola Nomhle Ngwenya jaaka e le ngwana wa mosetsanyana wa mothomontsho wa ntlha go iponela PhD mo dithutong tsa saense kwa yunibesiti ya Wits a na fela le dingwaga di le Mme P Khoza yo a tlhophilweng go nna Moporesitente wa Kopano ya bo 42 ya ICAO e e neng e tshwerwe go tloga ka la bo 27 go fitlha ka la bo 7 Diphalane 2022 kwa Montreal, Canada.

src: Meelye Die Kabinet dra sy medelye oor aan die naasbestaandes en vriende van: Parlementslid, me Tina Joemat-Pettersson, wat die Voorsitter van die Nasionale Vergadering se Portefeuljekomitee oor Polisie was, en voorheen gedien het as Minister van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye en as Minister van Energie.
tgt: Melaetsa ya Matshediso Kabinete e romela matshediso a yone le kutlwelobotlhoko kwa go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa: Tokololo ya Palamente, Mme Tina Joemat-Pettersson, yo e neng e le Monnasetulo mo Komiting ya Kokoanotheomolao ya Bosetšhaba e e Samaganang le Merero ya Lephata la Sepodisi, yo mo nakong e e fetileng e neng e le Tona ya Lefapha la Temothuo, Dikgwa le Boreatlhapi, yo gape e kileng ya nna Tona ya Merero ya Metlakase le Maokwane.

src: Sy het ook as LUR vir Onderwys in die Noord-Kaap gedien.
tgt: O kile gape ya nna Mokhuduthamaga (MEC) wa Thuto kwa porofenseng ya gaabo ya Kapa Bokone.

src: Sy was 'n lid van die Nasionale Uitvoerende Komitee van die African National Congress (ANC) en die ANC-vroueliga, en ’n bevrydingstryd-aktivis as lid van die United Democratic Front.
tgt: E ne gape e le yo mongwe wa ba ba nang le maemo a magolo mo Komiting ya Baeteledipele ba Mokgatlho wa Naga wa African National Congress (ANC) le mo Mokgatlhong wa basadi wa ANE ne e le molwelakgaratlho mo mokgatlhong wa dipolotiki wa United Democratic Front.

src: Kgoshi Kgagudi Kenneth Sekhukhune, Kgoshi ya Marota Mohlaletse, Hlabirw’a a Bauba en langdienende voormalige heerser van die Bapedi-koninkryk.
tgt: Kgosi Kgagudi Kenneth Sekhukhune, Kgoshi ya Marota Mohlaletse, Hlabirw’a a Bauba yo e leng kgale a okame maemo a Modisabogosi jwa Morafe wa Bapedi.

src: Energie.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die verbetering in Eskom se energiebeskikbaarheidsfaktor, wat nou nader aan 70% is.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke maemo a a tokafetseng a Eskom a go Seketsa Motlakase, mo motlakase o o sekeditsweng o atumelang sekgala se se kanaka 70%.

src: Sowat 400 megawatt (MW) is by die netwerk gevoeg en beplande instandhouding het binne ’n kort tydjie verbeter.2 Die Kabinet het ook kennis geneem van die besluit deur die Department van Bosbou, Visserye en die Omgewing se Nasionale Luggehaltebeampte om Eskom uitstel te gee om aan die minimum emissiestandaarde by die Kusile-kragstasie in Mpumalanga te voldoen, onderhewig aan sekere streng voorwaardes.3 Die uitstel sal Eskom in staat stel om herstelwerk te doen aan die skoorsteenpyp wat op 23 Oktober 2022 beskadig is.
tgt: Go okeditswe motlakase ka dimekawate di le 400 mo diyuniting tsa tlamelo ya motlakase mme gape le matsholo a tlhokomelo le tsosoloso ya meago le dithoto a diragaditswe ka bonako.

src: Die kragvoorsiener sal ook drie tydelike skoorsteenpype bou, wat na verwagting 2100 MW krag na die nasionale netwerk sal terugbesorg en beurtkrag met twee vlakke sal verminder.4 Die Kabinet het beklemtoon dat die regering tot die Just Energy Transition (JET) -oorgangstydperk verbind is en vasbeslote is om die uitwerking van klimaatsverandering te verlig.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse tshwetso e e tserweng ke Motlhankedi wa Setheo sa Naga sa Merero ya Maemo a Mowa sa Lefapha la Merero ya Dikgwa, ya Botshwaro jwa Ditlhapile le ya Tikologo jaaka a neetse Eskom tetla ya go atolosa paka e e neng e beilwe ya go obamela Maemo a Kgotlhelo ya Mowa wa Tikologo ka Seteišene sa Motlakase sa Kusile kwa porofenseng ya Mpumalanga, mme tetla eno e na le maemo a a bogale a a tshwanetsweng gore a obamelwe.

src: Die JET-oorgangstydperk, wat in 2020 van stapel gestuur is, beoog om ’n vlak van “net zero” koolstofvrystelling teen 2050 te bereik.5 Die Kabinet het Suid-Afrikaners wat elektrisiteit, veral tydens spitstye, spaarsaam gebruik, bedank.
tgt: Go atolosiwa ga nako eno go tla naya Eskom tšhono ya gore e kgone go baakanya dikarolo tse di senyegileng ka la bo 23 Diphalane 2022.

src: Ons gesamentlike energiepogings het gehelp om laer fases van beurtkrag te weeg te bring.
tgt: Setlamo seno sa motlakase se tla aga gape le dikarolo tse dingwe gape di le tharo tsa motlakase tse go solofetsweng gore di tla tlhagisa motlakase o o kanaka dimekawate di le 2 100 tse di tla tsenngwang mo diyuniting tsa naga tsa tlamelo ya motlakase gore ditiragalo tsa motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri di kgone go fokodiwa ka magato a le mabedi.

src: Die besoek het Suid-Afrika se verhouding met die twee lande op die gebied van groen waterstof, hernubare energie en die JET-oorgangstydperk verstewig.2 Die besoek het ook ’n groep beleggers na Suid-Afrika gebring om die hoë vlakke van samewerking en goeie verhoudings tussen die land en die twee belangrike Europese vennote te versterk.3 Tydens die gesamentlike amptelike samesprekings is ’n Meorandum van Verstandhouding op die gebied van groen waterstof tussen Suid-Afrika en Nederland onderteken, terwyl ’n ooreenkoms tussen Suid-Afrika en Denemarke oor Ontwikkelingsamewerking rakende die 2017-Energievenootskapprogram gewysig is.
tgt: Moporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o ne a le teng mo kopanong eno, e maitlhomo a yona e leng go tlhama tumelano e ntšhwa magareng ga dinaga tsa Bokone le tsa Borwa go samagana le matsapa a phetogo ya maemo a loapi, a tlhabololo le a dikoloto.

src: Hoewel groei steeds stadig plaasvind, skep ons veerkragtige ekonomie steeds werk, al is dit nie teen die voorkeurtempo nie.2 Ingrypings soos die Presidensiële Indiensnemingstimulusprogram help om die gety te laat draai.
tgt: Kabinete e itumeletse Leeto le le tshwerweng ka katlego la Dinaga di le Pedi la Semmuso la go Jela Naga ya Rona Nala la Ditlhogo tsa Naga ya Netherlands le ya Denmark mo Tonakgolo ya naga ya Netherlands, e bong Rre Mark Rutte mmogo le Tonakgolo ya naga ya Denmark, e bong Mme Mette Frederiksen ba jetseng naga nala mme seno se dira gore botsalano jwa dinaga tse pedi tseno bo gagamale le gofeta mo mererong ya leokwane la gase le le sa kgotlheleng tikologo, motlakase wa go fetlhiwa ka ditsela tse dintšhwa mmogo le mo go Fetoleng Maemo a Motlakase (JET).

src: Die vallei sal geleenthede skep vir projekte wat waterstofinisiatiewe in spilpunte sal begin met die doel om ekonomiese groei en werkskepping te bevorder.
tgt: Kabinete e kelekile Dipalopalo tsa Badiri tsa Kotara ya sešweng tseo di golotsweng ke Setheo sa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo sa Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) tseo di bontshang gore go maphata mangwe a ditiro a badiri ba fokoditsweng mo go ona mmogo le maphata a mangwe a mo go ona badiri ba oketsegileng.

src: ’n Ministeriële taakspan is na Diepsloot in Gauteng ontplooi om saam met gemeenskapsleiers te werk om hul geskilpunte op te los.2 Die Kabinet het ’n beroep op die gemeenskappe van Diepsloot en ander gebiede gedoen om saam met die regering, plaaslike raadslede en die polisie te werk om kwessies soos misdaad op te los.
tgt: Kabinete e lebogile gape le tumelano e e utlwanetsweng e e ka ga maikemisetso a go tlhoma Setlhopha sa Merero ya Tiro ya Leokwane la Gase sa Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Jeremane, mme tumelano eno e saenilwe ke Tona e e rweleng maikarabelo a Motlakase mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente e bong Ngaka Kgosientsho Ramokgopa mmogo le Motlatsamotšhanseliri wa Naga ya Jeremane e bong Robert Habeck.

src: Die verslag gee ’n uiteensetting van die maatreëls wat Suid-Afrika tref om marteling en mishandeling van sy burgers te voorkom.2 Suid-Afrika het die Konvensie in 2000 onderteken en dit in 2008 bekragtig.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse Leeto la Moporesitente Ramaphosa go Etela ka Mabaka a Tiro Kopano ya Ditlhogo tsa Mebuso le Dipuso tsa SACU e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Nageng ya Bogosi ya Eswatini ka Labone, 29 Seetebosigo 2023.

src: In ooreenstemming met Artikel 17 van die Opsionele Protokol tot die KTM, is een van die verpligtinge wat aan partye opgelê word om binnelandse meganismes vir die voorkoming van marteling in hul Nasionale Voorkomingsmeganisme, in plek te stel.3 Oor die afgelope 29 jaar het die demokratiese regering in Suid-Afrika van ou apartheidswette en -instellings ontslae geraak, nuwe demokratiese instellings gebou en wette wat op grondwetlike regte en vryhede gegrond is, geskep.4 Lede van die publiek kan bewerings van marteling en mishandeling direk by die Polisie se Onafhanklike Ondersoekdirektoraat aanmeld.
tgt: Fa e sale mokgotla ono o tlhomiwa mo ngwageng wa 1910, SACU ke mokgatlho wa bogologolo wa tlhatlhobo ya dithoto kwa melelwaneng.

src: Suid-Afrika het ook ’n goed funksionerende nasionale Meseregtekommissie, wat gestig is om grondwetlike demokrasie te ondersteun.
tgt: Mo kopanong eno go tlilwe ka ditharabololo le go abelana ka tshedimosetso e e mo dinakong mabapi le go tsenya tirisong Leano la go Diragatsa Maano a SACU mo Ngwageng 2022 - 2027.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klarings.
tgt: Leano leno la SACU le tsentswe tirisong ka Seetebosigo 2022 go dirisiwa jaaka leano la go tsenyeletsa tirisanommogo mo kgaolong mo mererong ya tlhatlhobo ya dithoto kwa melelwaneng mmogo le go dira gore botsalano magareng ga dinagaleloko di le tlhano bo gagamale le go feta mmogo le go itseela ditšhono tse di tlang le Letsholo la Kgwebisano ya Dinaga tsa Kontinente ya Aforika Ntle le go Kgorelediwa ke Sepe.

src: Dit sal voorsiening maak vir geteikende ondersteuning aan munisipaliteite wat hulp nodig het, sowel as vir die monitering van munisipaliteite om hul uitvoerende verpligtinge ingevolge die Grondwet of ander wetgewing na te kom.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuetse mo baaging ba Diepsloot mmogo le mo baaging ba mafelo a mangwe gore ba dirisane le puso, bakhanselara ba dikgaolo tsa bona mmogo le mapodisi go rarabolola matsapa a a jaaka bosenyi.

src: Belastingbetalers word aangemoedig om hul opgawes op eFiling of op die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens (SAID) se MobiApp in te dien.2 Die belasting-indienproses is nou nog eenvoudiger en die SAID sal vanjaar voortgaan met outo-assessering.
tgt: CIS, e e saleng e phasaladiwa ka ngwaga wa 2022 gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona, maitlhomo a yona ke go dira gore kontinente ya Aforika e nne mmamoratwa fa go tla mo go beeletseng mo go yona, mme e dira seno ka go kgoboketsa babeeletsi ba ba botlhokwa go tswa kwa dinageng tsa boditšhaba le fa dinageng tsa mo kontinenteng tse di lebaganeng le diintaseteri tse di rileng.

src: Tussen 1 en 7 Julie 2023, word belastingbetalers per SMS of e-pos in kennis gestel as hulle gekies is om ’n outo-assessering te ontvang.
tgt: Leano leno le ikaegile ka dikarolo tse di botlhokwa tse naga e batlang go beelediwe mo go tsona mmogo le mo kgodisong ya ikonomi e leng dilo tse di jaaka go oketsa palo ya batho ba ba nang le ditiro, go fokotsa tshokolo, mmogo le go ema nokeng dikgato tsa go fetola ikonomi ya rona gore e itshetlege mo didirisiweng tse di sa kueletseng mesi e mentsi mmogo le mo go nneng le motlakase o o sa tshabeleng ruri.

src: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.
tgt: Mogwanto o o Rebotsweng ke ba Lekgotla la Naga la Dithekesi tsa Aforika Borwa (SANTACO) kwa Porofenseng ya Kapa Bophirima Kabinete e lomilwe tsebe ka ga dikgogakgogano tse di tsweletseng magareng ga SANTACO ya kwa porofenseng ya Kapa Bophirima le Puso ya Masepala wa Motsekapa, mo dikgogakgogano tseno di feleditseng di ile magoletsa mo di tlhotlheleditseng mogwanto gore o feletse go dirisiwa dikgoka ka ntlha ya dithekesi tse puso ya masepala wa motsekapa e di thopileng.

src: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.
tgt: Kabinete e kgalemela ka mafoko a a bogale tirisodikgoka le botlhokotsebe jo bo diragalang kwa Motsekapa mme e ikuela mo go SANTACO go netefatsa gore mogwanto wa bona o se nne le mmudubudu e bile o se gatakake ditshwanelo tsa batho ba bangwe.

src: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.
tgt: Mo ntlheng eno, re bone gore mo matsatsing a le mabedi a a fetileng ga go a begiwa tirisodikgoka epe.

src: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.
tgt: Le fa go le jalo, bathankedi ba Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) le ba bangwe ba ditheo tsa molao ba laetswe gore ba nne ba le malalaalaotswe go dira bonnete jwa gore ditiragalo tsa tirisodikgoka di nne ka fa tlase ga taolo go dira gore baagi ba kgone go tsaya maeto a go leba kwa dikolong, kwa ditirong le kwa mabakeng a bona.

src: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.
tgt: Kabinete e lomilwe tsebe gape le ka dikgato tsa puso ya Masepala wa Motsekapa tse di ka ga go tsenya tirisong melao e e itlhametseng yona e e sa tsamaisaneng le melao ya naga ka bobedi e bong Molao wa Dijanaga tse di Tsamayang mo Mebileng ya Naga wa ngwaga wa 1996 (Molao wa bo 93 wa 1996) mmogo le Molao wa Naga wa Dijanaga tse di Rwalang Baagi wa ngwaga wa 2009 (Molao wa bo 5 wa 2009), eno ke melao e e laolang ditlolo tsa melao mo mebileng mmogo le dikotlhao tsa ditlolo tse di farologaneng tsa melao, mmogo le dikotlhao tse di buang ka go thopiwa ga dijanaga.

src: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.
tgt: Kabinete e laetse Tona ya Lefapha la Dipalangwa, Mme Sindisiwe Chikunga, go dira bonnete jwa gore thekesi nngwe le nngwe e e dirang mo mebileng ya rona e ntshiwa mo tseleng fa e le gore ga e obamele melao ya naga.

src: Fight against illegal mining.
tgt: Go Lwantshana le Bogodu jwa Dirašwa tsa Meepoe.

src: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisiwa ke dikgato tsa go romela kwa Riverlea, kwa Johannesburg, setlhopha se se itlhophileng sa sepodisi seo se tla enngwang nokeng ke sesole, go samagana le ditiragalo tsa bogodu jwa dirašwa tsa meepo mo motseng oo.

src: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.
tgt: Mo godimo ga seno, Kabinete e akgola katlego e e nnileng teng ya go tshwara babelaelwa ba ditiro tsa bogodu jwa dirašwa tsa meepo ba feta ba le 194 mme e laetse ditheo tsa molao go direla ka bonako go fedisa botlhokotsebe jono mmogo le jo bongwe jo bo setlhogo ka fa nageng.

src: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.
tgt: Lefapha la Metswedi ya Dimenerale le Eneji (DMRE) le ikanne gore le tla tswalela meepo yotlhe e e sa tlholeng e dira mmogo le mesima yotlhe ya meepo eo kwa Riverlea fa kgwedi ya Lwetse mo ngwageng ono a garela, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe le tla garela maano a go tswalela e mengwe ya meepo e e jaaka eno ka fa nageng ka bophara.

src: The security situation in Niger.
tgt: Maemo a Pabalesego kwa Nageng ya Niger.

src: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse seabe se maemo a pabalesego kwa nageng ya Niger se nang le sona mo difofaneng tse di tsayang maeto go tswa mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa kgotsa mo dinageng tsa Borwa jwa Aforika go leba kwa dinageng tsa Bophirima jwa Yuropa, mmogo le go tlhola ditlamorago tse di sa jeseng diwelang mo dikgwebong le mo baaging mmogo le mo ditlamong tsa difofane tse di ntseng di leka go itharabologelwa go tswa mo matsapeng a a nnileng teng mo ngwageng wa 2019 ka ntlha ya leroborobo la bolwetse jwa Mogare wa Corona (COVID-19).

src: Cabinet reiterated government’s condemnation of the coup in Niger and the call for the speedy restoration of a democratic order, and also noted the initiative to restore normality under the Economic Community of West African States.
tgt: Kabinete e boeleditse mafoko a yona a go kgalema ditiragalo tsa menolopuso kwa Niger mmogo le go ikuela gore go direlwe ka bonako go busetsa maemo a temokerasi sekeng, e bile gape Kabinete e nopotse gape le dikgato tse go samaganweng natso tsa go busetsa maemo sekeng tseo Ditheo tsa Dikgwebo kwa Dinageng tsa Bophirima jwa Aforika di samaganeng natso.

src: Russia-Africa Summit.
tgt: Samiti e e Magareng ga Naga ya Russia le Dinaga tsa Aforika.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa was amongst other African leaders who attended the Second Russia-Africa Summit, in St Petersburg in the Russian Federation on 27 and 28 July 2023.
tgt: Moporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa ke o mongwe wa baeteledipele ba dinaga tsa kontinente ya Aforika ba ba neng ba tsenetse Samiti ya Bobedi e e Magareng ga Naga ya Russia le Dinaga tsa Aforika, kwa St Petersburg kwa nageng ya Federeišene ya Russia ka la bo 27 le la bo 28 Phukwi 2023.

src: This summit adopted the Russia-Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan which focuses on strengthening cooperation in areas of politics and security, economics, humanitarian matters, and interests of mutual benefit and prosperity.
tgt: Mo samiting eno go ne ga tsewa tshwetso ya go sala morago Leano la go Tsaya Dikgato tse di ka ga Foramo ya Tirisanommogo Magareng ga Naga ya Russia le Dinaga tsa Aforika leo le gagamatsang tirisanommogo mo dikarolong tsa dipolotiki le tsa pabalesego, tsa ikonomi, mo mererong e e ka ga go tswa baagi thuso, mmogo le mo dikarolong tse di ka ga go unngwelwa le go atlega ga maphata otlhe.

src: On the sidelines of the summit, African Heads of State and Government who are part of the African Peace Initiative on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine held follow-up talks with President Vladimir Putin on the previously discussed confidence-building measures that will create conditions for a negotiated settlement to ending the war.
tgt: Mo dikopanong tse dingwe tseo di sa ikaegang ka samiti eno, Bateledipele ba Dinaga le Dipuso tsa Aforika bao ba e leng karolo ya Letsholo la Kontinente ya Aforika la go Buisanela go Rena ga Kagiso mo ntweng e e runtseng magareng ga naga ya Russia le ya Ukraine ba ne ba buisana le Moporesitente Vladimir Putin go utlwa gore ke eng se se setseng se dirilwe fa e sale ka motsi oo ba neng ba tlile kwa go ene lantlha go buisanwa ka dikgato tsa go tiisa mmoko gore ntwa e tla fela ka go dira gore maphata a a lwang a kgone go buisanela go khutlisa ntwa eo.

src: Presidents Ramaphosa and Putin also held a bilateral meeting and discussed opportunities to increase trade between the two countries, and for the Russian Federation to increase investments in South Africa.
tgt: Moporesitente Ramaphosa le Moporesitente Putin le bona ba ne ba tshwara kopano ya bona ya botsalano jwa dinaga di le pedi go buisanela merero e e ka ga go tlhatlosa kgwebisano magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi, mmogo le gore naga ya Russia e oketse dipeeletso tsa yona mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: BRICS Summit Hosting Readiness.
tgt: Go Ipaakanyetsa go Tshwara Kopano ya BRICS Kabinete e atlhaatlhile dithulaganyo tsotlhe mme e kgotsofetse gore Aforika Borwa e ipaakantse sentle go ka tshwara Samiti ya bo 15 ya BRICS kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 22 go fitlha ka la bo 24 Phatwe 2023.

src: Cabinet was apprised that it is all systems go in terms of South Africa’s readiness to host the 15th BRICS Summit in Johannesburg from 22 to 24 August 2023.
tgt: Kopano ya bofelo ya Ditona tsa BRICS – e bong Kopano ya Ditona tsa Temothuo tsa BRICS – e mo tseleng, mme Kopano ya Ditona tsa Merero ya Tirisanommogo le Dinaga tsa Boditšhaba, ya Ditona tsa Pabalesego, ya Ditona tsa Diintaseteri, ya Ditona tsa Saense, ya Ditona tsa Merero ya Badiri le Ditiro, ya Ditona tsa Ditlhaeletsano, ya Ditona tsa Boitekanelo mmogo le ya Ditona tsa Merero ya go Dira Metseseteropo di setse di konoseditse dipegelo tsa tsona gore Samiti ya Baeteledipele e kgone go ka simolola.

src: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.
tgt: Letsholo la go Jela Setšhaba Nala la BRICS go leba kwa makaleng a a farologaneng mo setšhabeng le lona le garetswe.

src: These engagements provided governments, organisations, experts and academics from the BRICS nations an opportunity to discuss issues of mutual interest that will enable informed decision-making during the BRICS Summit.
tgt: Dipuisano tseno di neetse ditšhono go dipuso, mekgatlho, baitseanape le barutegi go tswa kwa dinageng tsa BRICS, go buisana ka dintlha tse di ba amang botlhe tse di tla dirang gore ditshwetso tse di tsewang mo Samiting ya BRICS di bo di ikaegile ka dintlha tse di utlwagalang.

src: National Development Plan (NDP) Ten-Year Review.
tgt: Go Sekaseka Dingwaga di le Lesome tsa Leano la Tlhabololo ya Naga (NDP).

src: Cabinet welcomed the Ten-Year Review of the NDP by the National Planning Commission that pointed out that the economy remained structured in a manner that does not serve the interests of all South Africans, which is a major reason behind increasing levels of poverty and inequality.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula tsiboso ya Komiti ya go Loga Maano a Naga e e ka ga dikgato tsa go Sekaseka Dingwaga di le Lesome tsa NDP e e nopotseng gore ikonomi e santse e rulagantswe ka tsela e e sa tsweleng maAforika Borwa otlhe mosola, mme seno ke sona selo se segolo se se dirang gore maemo a tshokolo le a go se lekalekane a tswelele go golela ruri.

src: Government remains committed to restructuring and transforming the economy to serve the interests of all South Africans.
tgt: Puso e santse e eme ka le lereng e batla go rulaganya sešwa le go fetola ikonomi gore e tswele maAforika Borwa otlhe mosola.

src: The 25th July marked the First Anniversary since President Ramaphosa announced the Energy Action Plan.
tgt: Motlakase Ka la bo 25 Phukwi 2023 e ne e le Ngwaga Poo fa e sale Moporesitente Ramaphosa a itsise Leano la go Tseela Motlakase Dikgato.

src: Cabinet welcomed the progress made to date to implement the Energy Action Plan, which continues to register an improvement in the Energy Availability Factor and improvement in the stages of load-shedding.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisiwa ke kgatelopele e e setseng e dirilwe fa e sale leano leno le tsenngwa tirisong, mme le tswelela go nna le katlego mo go Direng gore Motlakase o Nne Teng ka fa nageng mmogo le mo go fokotseng dikgato tsa motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri.

src: Tourism Cabinet is pleased that the Tourism statistics for June 2023 show that our tourism sector is slowly but surely recovering from the devastating effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.
tgt: Bojanala Kabinete e itumedisiwa ke gore dipalopalo tsa lephata la Bojanala mo kgweding ya Seetebosigo 2023 di bontsha gore lekala la bojanala le ntse le gola ka iketlo go tswa mo matsapeng a a tlhodilweng ke leroborobo la COVID-19.

src: The June 2023 statistics from Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) show that the volume of arrivals, departures and travellers in transit increased for both South African residents and foreign travellers between June 2022 and June 2023.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa Seetebosigo tse di dirilweng ke ba Setheo sa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo sa Aforika Borwa (Stats SA) di bontsha gore dipalopalo tsa batho ba ba jelang naga nala, ba ba tswang ka naga le ba ba etelang dikarolo tsa naga ka dijanaga e ka tswa e le baagi ba naga ya Aforika Borwa le baagi ba dinaga tsa kwa ntle e oketsegile magareng ga kgweid ya Seetebosigo 2022 le ya Seetebosigo 2023.

src: Economy Cabinet welcomed Stats SA’s report of a drop in consumer inflation from per cent in May to per cent in June 2023, which is the largest decline since May 2020.
tgt: Ikonomi Kabinete e itumedisiwa ke pegelo ya ba Stats SA e e reng maemo a phetogotlhotlhwa a wetse kwa tlase go tloga mo go diperesente di le ka kgwedi ya Motsheganong 2023 go fitlha mo go di le mo kgweding ya Seetebosigo 2023, mme eno ke palo e kgolo thata e maemo ano a wetseng kwa tlase ka yona fa e sale mo kgweding ya Motsheganong 2020.

src: This drop shows the resilience of our economy, which has been further buoyed by the South Africa Reserve Bank’s decision to leave the repo rate unchanged at 8.25 per cent.
tgt: Go fokotsega gono ga phetogotlhotlhwa go bontsha ka fao ikonomi ya rona e ngangabetseng ka gona, mme yona e filwe maatla gape le ke tshwetso ya Bankakgolo ya Aforika Borwa e e sa fetolang maemo a boleng jwa madi a dikadimo a dibanka mme e a tlogetse gona fo a leng ka diperesente di le Molaotlhomo wa Puo ya Diatla ya Aforika Borwa (SASL) Kabinete e itumeletse dikgato tsa sešweng tse Moporesitente Ramaphosa a di tsereng tsa go saena Molaotlhomo wa SASL go nna molao, mme seno se raya gore SASL jaanong ke Puo ya bo 12 ya semmuso ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: This will promote the rights of about 600 000 SASL users in South Africa.
tgt: Seno se tla tsholetsa ditshwanelo tsa batho ba ka nna 600 000 ba ba dirisang puo eno ya SASL ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Pre-release calendar for the publication of the quarterly crime statistics for the 2023/24 financial year Cabinet approved the pre-release calendar for the publication of the quarterly crime statistics for the 2023/24 financial year.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete Go Gololwa Pele ga Nako ga Kgatiso ya Kotara ya Boraro ya Dipalopalo tsa Dikgetse tsa Bosenyi mo Ngwageng wa Matlole wa 2023/2024 Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go gololwa ga letlha la Go Gololwa Pele ga Nako ga Kgatiso ya Kotara ya Boraro ya Dipalopalo tsa Dikgetse tsa Bosenyi mo Ngwageng wa Matlole wa 2023/2024.

src: The crime statistics will be released in August and November 2023 for quarters one and two, and February and May 2024 for quarter three and quarter four respectively.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa dikgetse tsa botlhokotsebe tsa kotara ya ntlha le ya bobedi di tla phasaladiwa ka kgwedi ya Phatwe le ya Ngwanaitseele 2023, mme ka kgwedi ya Tlhakole le ya Motsheganong 2024 go tla phasaladiwa tsa kotara ya boraro le ya bone ka go latelana ga tsona.

src: The frequent release of crime statistics is important for monitoring crime trends and better decision-making in the fight against crime.
tgt: Go phasaladiwa gangwe le gape ga dipalopalo tsa dikgetse tsa botlhokotsebe go botlhokwa thata mo go thuseng go disa maemo a botlhokotsebe le mo go thuseng go tsaya ditshweetso tse di botoka mo go lwantshaneng le botlhokotsebe.

src: Financial Inclusion Policy Cabinet approved the Financial Inclusion Policy for implementation.
tgt: Pholisi e e Buang ka go Thusa Batho Botlhe ka Matlole Kabinete e neseditse pula Pholisi e e Buang ka go Thusa Batho Botlhe ka Matlole.

src: The policy forms part of government’s reforms of the financial sector regulations and in line with the Twin Peaks model of National Treasury.
tgt: Pholisi eno ke karolo ya dikgato tsa puso tsa go fetola melawanataolo ya lekala la matlole go ya ka mokgwatirelo wa Twin Peak wa Lefapha la Matlole a Naga.

src: The policy, amongst others, aims to ensure better market conduct and the treatment of customers in the financial sector.
tgt: Mo gare ga tse dingwe tse dintsi, maitlhomo a pholisi eno ke go dira gore maemo a ditirelo le a go dirisana le badirisi ba ditirelo tseno mo mebarakeng ya tsa matlole e tokafale.

src: The purpose is to ensure that financial institutions conduct business in ways that are fair to customers, prevent practices that undermine the integrity of financial markets, and build confidence in the financial system.
tgt: Maitlhomo a yona ke go dira bonnete jwa gore ditheo tsa matlole di tsamaisa kgwebo ka mokgwa o o sa tlhophololeng badirisi ba ditirelo tsa tsona, go thibela ditheo tsa matlole go tsamaisa kgwebo ka tsela e e sa tsamaisaneng le eo dimaraka tsa matlole di tshwanetseng go tsamaisiwa ka tsona mmogo le go dira gore batho ba nne le tshepo e e feletseng mo ditheong tsa matlole.

src: The implementation of the policy will ensure that the country strengthens its financial systems to support economic growth and promote access to financial services and financial inclusion for all citizens.
tgt: Go tsenyeng tirisong pholisi eno go tla dira bonnete jwa gore naga e kgona go gagamatsa dithulaganyo tsa matlole gore di kgone go ema nokeng kgolo ya ikonomi le go dira gore batho ba bantsi ba kgone go fitlhelela ditirelo tsa matlole le go dira gore baagi botlhe go se itlhokomoloswe bona mo mererong ya matlole.

src: It is an acknowledgment that while levels of access have improved in transactional accounts, this has not reflected across many other financial products and services.
tgt: Re a amogela gore le fa tota batho ba bantsi ba na le diakhaonto, diakhanto tseno ga di a gasagana go ya ka ditirelo tsa matlole tse dintsi tse di leng teng.

src: The policy is available on the National Treasury website: WEBTOKEN Bills.
tgt: Pholisi eno e ka fitlhelwa mo webesaeteng ya Lefapha la Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba ya WEBTOKEN Melaotlhomo.

src: National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) Amendment Bill of 2023.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Setheo sa Bosekisi jwa Naga wa Ngwaga wa 2023.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the draft NPA Amendment Bill of 2023 to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Setheo sa Bosekisi jwa Naga wa Ngwaga wa 2023.

src: The Bill amends the NPA Act, 1998 (Act 32 of 1998) to provide for the establishment of the Investigating Directorate as a permanent entity within the NPA and to also strengthen its investigative powers.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o kwalola sešwa Molao wa NPA (Molao wa bo 32 wa 1998) gore jaanong o kgone go letlelela gore go tlhomiwe Kantoro ya Dipatlisiso e e tla nnelang ruri mo setehong sa NPA mmogo le go gagamatsa maatla a go dira dipatlisiso.

src: The Regulation of Interception of Communications and Provision of Communication-related Information Amendment Bill.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Molawanataolo wa Dithata tsa go Reetsa le go Gatisa Mafoko a Batho fa ba le mo Megaleng Mmogo le Tshedimosetso ya Mothale oo.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the draft Amendment Bill to Parliament, which amends the Regulation of Communications and Provision of Communication-related Information Act (RICA), 2002 (Act 70 of 2002).
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo ono ono o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa, mme ona o kwalola sešwa Molawanataolo wa Dithata tsa go Reetsa le go Gatisa Mafoko a Batho fa ba le mo Megaleng Mmogo le Tshedimosetso ya Mothale (RICA) (Molao wa bo 70 wa 2002).

src: The amendments are largely to provide adequate safeguards to protect the right to privacy, as buttressed by the rights of access to courts, freedom of expression of the media and legal privilege in line with the 2021 Constitutional Court judgement that found the RICA of 2002 to be unconstitutional.
tgt: Maitlhomomagolo a dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa ke go dira gore go nne le dithata tse di lekaneng tsa go sireletsa ditshwanelo tsa batho gore go se italetswe mo dikgang tsa bona go se tlhokagalo, go dira jaaka go laetswe mo ditshwanelong tsa go leba kwa kgotlatshekelo, mo ditshwanelong tsa go se kgorelediwe go ntsha se se mo mafatlheng ga bobegakgang jo bo sa ilediweng go dira tiro ya jona mmogo le go ya le ka ditshwanelo tsa semolao tse ka ngwaga wa 2021 Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo e ntshitseng katlholo ka tsona mme ya fitlhela gore RICA ya ngwaga wa 2002 ga e tsamaisane le molaotheo.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Go Thapiwa Pele batho botlhe ba thapiwa go tla tlhatlhobiwa makwalo a bona a dithuto le ditlankana dingwe tse di tlhokagalang.

src: Mr Percy Sechemane as Chief Executive Officer of the Trans -Caledon Tunnel Authority.
tgt: Rre Percy Sechemane o thapilwe go nna Mokaedikhuduthamagamogolo wa Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority.

src: Ms Thathakahle Nonkqubela Jordan-Dyani as Director-General (DG) at the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies.
tgt: Mme Thathakahle Nonkqubela Jordan-Dyani o thapilwe go nna Mokaedikakaretso (DG) kwa Lefapheng la Ditlhaeletsano le Thekenoloji ya Dijithale.

src: Mr Duncan Pieterse as DG at National Treasury.
tgt: Rre Duncan Pieterse o thapilwe go nna DG kwa Lefapheng la Matlotlo a Naga.

src: Ms Qinisile Precious Delwa as Deputy DG (DDG): Enterprise Development and Entrepreneurship at the Department of Small Business Development (DSBD).
tgt: Mme Qinisile Precious Delwa o thapilwe go nna Motlatsamokaedikakaretso (DDG) mo lekaleng la Boitshimololedikgwebo ka fa Lefapheng la Tlhokomelo ya Dikgwebopotlana (DSBD).

src: Ms Mosa Keneilwe Makhele as DDG: Sector Policy and Research at the DSBMr Xolisa Mabhongo as DDG: Global Governance and Continental Agenda at the Department of International Relations and Cooperation.
tgt: Mme Mosa Keneilwe Makhele o thapilwe go nna DDG mo lekaleng la Kantoro e e Kwalang Dipholisi le go Dira Dipatlisiso ka fa Lefapheng la DSBRre Xolisa Mabhongo o thapilwe go nna DDG mo lekaleng la Merero ya Puso mo Lefatsheng le mo Kontinenteng ka fa Lefapheng la Dikamano le Tirisano le Dinaga tsa Boditšhaba.

src: Ms Rosinah Nghaka Dumalisile as DDG: Affordable Rental and Social Housing at the Department of Human Settlements.
tgt: Mme Rosinah Nghaka Dumalisile o thapilwe go nna DDG mo lekaleng la Merero ya go Hira Madulo le Mafelo a Tulo a go Agelwa Baagi ke Puso ka fa Lefapheng la Merero ya Bodulo.

src: Mr Thabo Kekana as DDG: Programmes and Projects at the DMRNational Radioactive Waste Disposal Institute Board of Directors:
tgt: Rre Thabo Kekana o thapilwe go nna DDG mo lekaleng la Matsholo le Diporojeke ka fa Lefapheng la Metswedi ya Dimenerale le Eneji (DMRE).

src: Ms Lemao Dorah Modise (Chairperson) Dr Wolsey Barnard (Deputy Chairperson) Ms Gratitude Ramphaka Dr Kgaugelo Chiloane (reappointment) and AdvDerick Block.
tgt: Monnasetulo Lemao Dorah Modise (Monnasetulo) Ngaka Wolsey Barnard (Motlatsamonnasetulo) Mme Gratitude Ramphaka Ngaka Kgaugelo Chiloane (o thapilwe sešwa) le Moatefokate Derick Block.

src: National Nuclear Regulator Board of Directors: Mr Protas Phili – Chairperson (reappointment) (ii) Ms Pinkie Deneo Peta (reappointment) (iii) Mr Paul Heeger(iv) Ms Nolubabalo Zolisa Zwakala Dr Pathmanathan Naidoo(vi) Dr Nandi Malumbazo(vii) Ms Theodorah Bahlekazi and(viii) Mr Happy Khambule.
tgt: Boto ya Botsamaisi jwa Bolaodi jwa Motlakase wa Naga: Rre Protas Phili – o thapilwe go nna Monnasetulo (o thapilwe sešwat) (ii) Mme Pinkie Deneo Peta (o thapilwe sešwa) (iii) Rre Paul Heeger(iv) Mme Nolubabalo Zolisa Zwakala Ngaka Pathmanathan Naidoo(vi) Ngaka Nandi Malumbazo(vii) Mme Theodorah Bahlekazi le(viii) Rre Happy Khambule.

src: Inkomati-Usuthu Catchment Management Agency Board of Directors: Ms Linda Carol Zulu (Chairperson)(ii) AdvGeraldine Khoza (Deputy Chairperson)(iii) Ms Shivon Wiggins(iv) Mr Sam Mthembu Mr Mokgobi Andrew Ramushu(vi) Mr Steven Matome Mathetsa and(vii) Ms Salome Chiloane-Nwabueze.
tgt: Boto ya Botsamaisi jwa Setheo sa Inkomati-Usuthu Catchment: Mme Linda Carol Zulu (o thapilwe go nna Monnasetulo)(ii) Moatefokate Geraldine Khoza (o thapilwe go nna Motlatsamonnasetulo)(iii) Mme Shivon Wiggins(iv) Rre Sam Mthembu Rre Mokgobi Andrew Ramushu(vi) Rre Steven Matome Mathetsa le(vii) Mme Salome Chiloane-Nwabueze.

src: State Information Technology Agency Board of Directors:
tgt: Boto ya Botsamaisi jwa Setheo sa Puso sa Merero ya Tlhokomelo ya Didirisiwa tsa Tshedimosetso le tsa Thekenoloji:

src: Mr Kiruben Pillay (Chairperson)(ii) Ms Lerato Petlele (Deputy Chairperson)(iii) Ms Khathu Sibanda(iv) Dr Lucienne Abraham(vi) Mr Luvuyo Keyise(vii) Mr Mandla Martin Mnisi (viii) Ms Renisha Naidoo(ix) Ms Nolitha Pietersen and Ms Laura Mseme.
tgt: Rre Kiruben Pillay (o thapilwe go nna Monnasetulo)(ii) Mme Lerato Petlele (Motlatsamonnasetulo)(iii) Mme Khathu Sibanda(iv) Ngaka Lucienne Abraham(vi) Rre Luvuyo keyise(vii) Rre Mandla Martin Mnisi (viii) Mme Renisha Naidoo(ix) Mme Nolitha Pietersen le Mme Laura MsemeDintlha tsa Sešweng.

src: Women’s Month.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Basadi.

src: South Africa is commemorating Women’s Month in August under the theme: “Accelerating socio-economic opportunities for empowerment of women” to pay tribute to the more than 20 000 women who marched to the Union Buildings in 1956 to protest against the oppressive pass laws of the apartheid government.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e keteka Kgwedi ya Basadi ka Phatwe ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Go potlakisa ditšhono mo baaging le mo ikonoming gore basadi ba tle ba matlafadiwe” mme seno ke go bontsha tlotlo go basadi ba feta 20 000 ba ba kileng ba gwantela kwa Union Buildings ka ngwaga wa 1956 ba ile go lwantshana le melao e e neng e gatelela batho ba bantsho ya go rwala dibukana tsa makwaloitshupo tsa puso ya tlhaolele.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to use the month not to only honour women who fought for our freedom but to also play our part to building a society that supports women empowerment and guarantees the safety of women and children.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go sola kgwedi eno mosola e seng fela ka go bontsha tlotlo go basadi ba ba lwetseng kgololesego ya rona mme gape le go nne le seabe mo go ageng setšhaba se se emang nokeng matlafatso ya basadi le go netefatsa gore basadi le bana ba tla nna ba babalesegile.

src: Mesages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: CongratulationsCabinet extends its congratulations and well wishes to: Netball Spar Proteas, for making it to the top six in the Netball World Cup.
tgt: Melaetsa ya go AkgolaKabinete e romela melaetsa ya yona ya go akgola le go eletsa masego kwa go: Setlhopha sa naga sa Netball Spar Proteas, jaaka se fitlheletse maemo a borataro mo metshamekong ya Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Bolotloa.

src: Cabinet called on all South Africans to use such unifying moments as an opportunity to reach out to fellow South Africans to build social cohesions and promote nation-building in a society where everyone feels welcomeBanyana Banyana, for making history by advancing to the last 16 of the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go sola mosola ditiragalo tsa mothale ono tsa go kopanya baagi ba Aforika Borwa go dira gore e nne seoposewngwe le go aga setšhaba se se tshwaraganeng gore yo mongwe le yo mongwe mo setšhabeng a se ipone e le letlhaodi.

src: Their incredible feats on the sporting field inspired the nation and they have flown the country’s flag high.
tgt: Banyana Banyana, jaaka ba dirile motlholo ka go fetela kwa makgaolakganyeng a ditlhopha di le 16 a Metshameko ya Kgwele ya Basadi ya Sejana sa Lefatshe sa ngwaga wa 2023.

src: ProfThuli Madonsela, the former Public Protector, for being appointed to the United Nations Scientific Advsory Board for Independent Advce on Breakthroughs in Science and Technology.
tgt: Metshameko e mentle e ba e tshamekileng e rotloeditse setšhaba mme ba dirile naga motlotlo tota.

src: Tatjana Schoenmaker, for winning gold in the 200m breaststroke and silver in the 100m breaststroke at the World Aquatics Championships in Fukuoka, Japan.
tgt: Moporofesara Thuli Madonsela, yo e kileng ya nna tlhogo ya Setheo sa Mosireletsi wa Setšhaba, jaaka a thapilwe mo go Boto ya Dinagakopano e e Dirang ka Dikeletso mo Mererong ya Ditlhagisiwa tsa Saense le Thekenoloji tse di Tlhamiwang.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Imam Achmad Cassiem (78), the former Robben Island prisoner, Pan Africanist Congress member and founding member of the Qibla Movement, who was a veteran of the Struggle against apartheid.
tgt: Tatjana Schoenmaker, jaaka a fentse gauta mo lebelong la go thuma go patlamilwe la dimitara di le 200 mmogo le go fenya selefera mo lebelong la go thuma go patlamilwe la dimitara di le 100 kwa Metshamekong ya Lefatshe ya Dinaledi tsa go Thuma e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Fukuoka, kwa nageng ya Japan.

src: BRICS XV Summit and the Johannesburg II Declaration South Africa hosted a successful BRICS XV Summit that adopted the historic Johannesburg II Declaration.
tgt: Samiti ya bo 15 ya BRICS mmogo le Tumelano ya Bobedi ya BRICS e e Tserweng kwa Johannesburg.1 Naga ya Aforika Borwa e ne e tshwere Samiti ya bo 15 ya BRICS mo go neng ga utlwanelwa Tumelano ya Bobedi ya BRICS e e Tserweng kwa Johannesburg.2 Kabinete e lebogile Setlhopha se se Neng se Emetse Naga ya Aforika Borwa se se neng se eteletswe pele ke Moporesitente wa Naga, Motlotlegi Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa yo a dirileng bonnete jwa gore samiti eno e tsamaya ka katlego mo tirong ya yona le mo tsamaisong ya yona.3 Moporesitente o tla ema naga ka lefoko go ba bolelela ka ga tseo di tsamaileng sentle ka ga Samiti ya bo 15 ya BRICS mmogo le ka ga merero e mengwe.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to Team South Africa ably led by our State President, His Excellency Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa who ensured the Summit was a great success at the level of both content and logistics.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e ne ya amogela Motlotlegi Moporesitente Xi Jinping wa Naga ya Rephaboliki ya Batho ba China mo Leetong la gagwe fa a ne a etetse ka fa nageng ka mabaka a tiro ka Labobedi la bo 22 Phatwe 2023, mme leeto leno le tshwerwe ka Labobedi pele ga kopano ya BRICS e ka simolola.

src: The President will address the nation on the successful BRICS XV Summit and other important matters.
tgt: Mo leetong leno gape go ne ga ketekiwa le sebaka sa dingwaga di le 25 dinaga ka bobedi e ntse e le ditsala mo mererong ya botsalano jwa dinaga tsa boditšhaba.

src: The People’s Republic of China is currently South Africa’s largest trading partner.
tgt: Ga jaanong Naga ya Rephaboliki ya Batho ba China ke naga e kgolo go gaisa e e gwebisanang le naga ya Aforika Borwa.

src: The People’s Republic of China had previously donated emergency power equipment worth R167 million and have since made available a grant of R500 million for development assistance.
tgt: Naga ya Rephaboliki ya Batho ba China mo nakong e e fetileng e abelane ka didirisiwa tsa motlakase go thiba phatlha fa go na le tshoganyetso tse di jang bokanaka R167 milione mme e bile gape e abelane le ka madithuso a le kanaka R500 milione go thusa go tlisa tlhabologo.

src: Cabinet welcomed the signing of various Agreements and Meoranda of Understanding between the South African government and the People’s Republic of China in the areas of trade, energy, higher education.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula Ditumelano tsotlhe tse di saenilweng mmogo le Dimemorantamo tsa go Dirisana Mmogo magareng ga puso ya naga ya Aforika Borwa mmogo le ya Naga ya Rephaboliki ya Batho ba China fa go tla mo maphateng a kgwebisano, motlakase le a ditheo tsa thuto e kgolwane.

src: Amongst the signed Agreements, it is the China-Africa Development Fund between the IDC and the Bank of China.
tgt: Gare ga ditumelano tse di saenilweng ke tse di ka ga Matlole a Dinaga tsa Aforika le China magareng ga Koporasi ya Tlhabololo ya Diintaseteri (IDC) le Banka ya China.

src: This Fund will stimulate increased investments in South Africa.
tgt: Matlole ano a tla thusa go fetlha dipeeletso gore di oketsege ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.6 .Kabinete e itumedisiwa gape le ke go bulelwa dikgoro tsa mebaraka ya naga ya kwa China gore maAforika Borwa a kgone go rekisetsa naga eno nama ya kgomo, mo godimo ga go bulelwa dikgoro tsa go e rekisetsa diabakhado.

src: These export opportunities will unlock new opportunities for our local producers including small scale farmers.
tgt: Ditšhono tseno tsa mebaraka ya go rekisetsa dinaga tsa boditšhaba di tla kgotholela batlhagisi ba naga ya rona ditšhono, go akaretsa le bona balemirui ba rona ba bannye.

src: South Africa is negotiating with BYD, the Chinese automaker and the world’s largest electric vehicle manufacturer for possible opening of a manufacturing plant in South Africa.
tgt: Naga ya Aforika Borwa e ntse e buisana le BYD, setlamo sa dijanaga sa China seo e leng setlamo se segolo mo lefatsheg sa dijanaga tsa motlakase mme ba leka go dira gore setlamo seno se bule feme ya go aga dijanaga tseno ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: This is in addition to the opening of the BAIC manufacturing plant (another Chinese automaker) in South Africa.
tgt: Seno ke morago ga gore setlamo sa BAIC (seo le sona e leng setlamo sa dijanaga sa China) le sona se bule feme ya go aga dijanaga ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Highlights of the Economy.
tgt: Dintlha tse Dikgolo tse di ka ga Ikonomi.

src: Quarterly Labour Force Survey Cabinet welcomed the Quarterly Labour Force Survey results for quarter 2 as released by Statistics South Africa, which indicated a slight decrease in unemployment rate from 32.9% in the first quarter to 32.6% in the second quarter.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse dipoelo tsa Pegelo ya Dipatlisiso tsa Kotara tsa Palo ya Badiri mabapi le kotara ya bobedi tseo di rebotsweng ke Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa, tseo di bontsitseng palo e e wetseng kwa tlase ya batho ba ba senang ditiro mme e fokotsegile go tloga mo go 32.9% mo kotareng ya ntlha go fitlha mo go 32.6% mo kotareng ya bobedi.

src: Cabinet is also pleased with 154 000 new jobs were created in the second quarter, taking the number of employed persons to million.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe gape le ke ditiro tse dintšhwa tse di tlhodilweng mo kotareng ya bobedi tse di kanaka 154 000, mme seno se okeditse palo ya batho ba ba nang le ditiro go nna ba le milione.

src: This is the 7th quarter of consecutive gains in employment inching South Africa closer to pre-Covid-19 pandemic employment figure of million.
tgt: Eno e setse e le kotara ya bosupa ka go latelana ga tsona palo ya ditiro e ntse e tlhatloga ka setsopolwana ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa mme re boela gannyane gannyane kwa palong ya badiri ya pele ga leroborobo la COVID-19 ya badiri ba le milione.

src: Cabinet has also noted the green shoots with the reduction of youth unemployment by 131,000 and an increase of 105,000 in the number of employed youth to million.
tgt: Kabinete gape e nopotse le tse dintle mo palo ya bašwa ba ba tlhokang ditiro e fokotsegileng ka ba le 131 000 mme re bone le koketsego ka ba le 105 000 mo palong yotlhe ya bašwa ba ba dirang go dira gore e nne ba le milione.

src: Cabinet further welcomed reports by StatsSA that the annual Consumer Price inflation slowed to 4.7% in July 2023, from 5.4% in June The annual inflation rate for goods was 5.5% for July 2023 from 6.3% in June 2023, whereas the inflation rate for services was 4.0% down from 4.5% in the same period.
tgt: Phetogotlhotlhwa ya Madi a Dikadimo (CPI).1Kabinete e itumedisitswe gape le ke dipegelo tsa Setheo sa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo sa Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) tse di reng CPI ya ngwaga le ngwaga e fokotsegile go fitlha mo go 4.7% ka Phukwi 2023, mme e tswa mo go 5.4% ka Seetebosigo 2023.2 Ka Phukwi 2023 maemo a phetogotlhotlhwa a ne a eme mo go 5.5% mme a tswa mo go 6.3% ka Seetebosigo 2023, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe lebelo la phetogotlhotlhwa mo ditirelong le wetse kwa tlase mo go 4.0% le tswa mo go 4.5% mo go yona paka eo.

src: Agro-Energy Fund to support agriculture and agribusinesses.
tgt: Matlole a go Tlamela Temothuo le Tlhagiso ya Motlakase go Ema Nokeng Balemirui le Dikgwebo tsa Temothuo.

src: On the 27th of August 2023, the Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development, collaboratively with the Land Bank, launched a R1,21 billion Agro-Energy Fund to support the agriculture and agribusiness sector to install alternative energy sources and continue with food, fibre and beverages production.
tgt: Ka la bo 27 Phatwe 2023 Lefapha la Temothuo, Pusetsodinaga le Tlhabololo ya Metsemagae, ka go dirisana mmogo le Banka e e Thusang Balemi ba Mafatshe ka fa Nageng, ba thankgolotse letsholo la matlole a le kanaka R1,21 bilione la Matlole a go Tlamela Temothuo le Tlhagiso ya Motlakase go Ema Nokeng Balemirui le Dikgwebo tsa Temothuo gore ba kgone go itsenyetsa didirisiwa tse dingwe tse di ka ba thusang ka motlakase gore ba se iphitlhelel ba palelwa ke go tlhagisa dijo le dino.

src: The sector is one of the intensive energy users and critical for the stability of South Africa’s food security, export earnings and employment, thus making this government intervention vital to ensure sustainability.
tgt: Lekala leno ke le lengwe la makala a a dirisang motlakase o montsi e bile le botlhokwa mo go direng gore naga ya Aforika Borwa e se felelwe ke dijo, e kgone go iponela letseno la go rekisetsa dinaga tsa kwa ntle mmogo le go tlhola ditiro, mme seno ke sona se se dirang gore go nne botlhokwa gore puso e thuse gore maemo a ritibale.

src: The Fund is inclusive and will support farming businesses of all scales in a Blended Finance approach, with the Land Bank managing the Fund.
tgt: Matlole ano a buletswe go thusa dikgwebo tsotlhe go sa kgathalesege bonnye kgotsa bogolo jwa tsona ka Dithuso tse di Farologaneng tsa Matlole, mme Banka e e Thusang Balemi ba Mafatshe ka fa Nageng ke yona e e tla laolang Matlole ano.

src: The Fund will also include all agriculture and agribusiness activities that are energy intensive.
tgt: Matlole ano a tla tshegetsa gape le ditiro totlhe tsa temothuo le tsa dikgwebo tsa temothuo tse di tsamaisanang le tiriso e ntsi ya motlakase.

src: Implementation of State Capture Commission recommendations The National Prosecuting Authority assets recovery is R.2 billion in the current MTEF period and R.55 billion of it is State Capture related.
tgt: Mo pakeng eno ya Letlhomeso la Tirisomatlole ya Pakagare (MTEF) Setheo sa Bosekisi jwa Naga se kgonne go busetsa madi a le kanaka R.2 bilione mme mo go ona matlole ano R.55 bilione ke e e neng e ile ka ntlha ya ditiragalo tsa Go Goga Puso ka Nko.

src: Cabinet has approved and tabled in Parliament eight of the fourteen new legislative amendments identified in our implementation plan.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng dikarolo tse dintšhwa di le robedi mo go di le 14 tsa melao e e kwalolotsweng sešwa tse di nopotsweng gore di tsenngwe mo Leanong la rona la Dikgato tse di tla Diragadiwang.

src: Work also continues to ensure that those responsible for state capture are held to account.
tgt: Ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe tiro e tsweletse go dira bonnete jwa gore botlhe ba ba nnileng le seabe mo ditiragalong tsa go go goga puso ka nko ba rweswa maikarabelo.

src: Fight against crime, corruption and illegal immigration The latest Quarterly Crime Statistics show that we must do more as a society to tackle the scourge of crime.
tgt: Go Lwantshana le Bogodu, Bonweenwee le go Kgabaganya Melelwano go se mo Molaong.

src: Cabinet calls on everyone to join the fight and to work collectively to make our homes, places of work and public spaces safer for all.
tgt: Pegelo ya mo malobeng e e ka ga Dipalopalo tsa Dikgetse tsa Bosenyi tsa Kotara e Nngwe le e Nngwe di a bontsha gore re le setšhaba re tshwanetse go tiisa letsogo fa re lwantshana le bosenyi.

src: Cabinet further welcomed the extension of the integrated crime-fighting “Operation Shanela” to other provinces, including the Northern Cape, Eastern Cape and KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa mo go motho mongwe le mongwe gore re ipope ngatananngwe mo go lwantshaneng le bosenyi le go nna seoposengwe mo go direng gore malapa a rona, mafelo a re dirang kwa go ona mmogo le mafelo a boitapoloso jwa baagi gore e nne mafelo a a babalesegileng mo bathong botlhe.

src: Cabinet noted the recent guilty plea and sentencing of six men accused of killing anti-corruption whistleblower, Ms Babita Deokaran, in August 2021.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe gape le ke dikgato tsa go godisa letsholo la go lwantshana le bosenyi la “Operation Shanela” kwa diporofenseng tse dingwe, g akaretsa ya Kapa Bokone, Kapa Botlhaba mmogo le ya KwaZulu-Natal.

src: It called on law-enforcement agencies to further investigate and ensure that masterminds behind the murder are brought to book.
tgt: Kabinete e sekegetse tsebe go ikatlhola ga banna ba le barataro ba ba latofadiwang ka go bolaya yo mongwe wa ba ba neng ba buletsa ditiragalo tsa bonweenwee, e bong Mme Babita Deokaran, ka Phatwe 2021.

src: Cabinet applauded the integrated approach in combating crime that recently led to the Department of Home Affairs intercepting 67 Pakistani nationals who tried to enter the country illegally at the OR Tambo International Airport on Sunday, 13 August 2023.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuetse gore ditheo tsa molao di tswelele go dira dipatlisiso go dira bonnete jwa gore bao ba logileng maano a polao eno ba di gama ba sa di tlhapela.

src: Held at the Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, the summit brought together University Vice-Chancellors, Deans, Principals and Council Chairpersons of TVET Colleges, Student Support Structures and Leadership, CEOs of SETAs, entities of the Departments of Higher Education and Science and Innovation, policymakers, survivors, peer educators, and change-makers, all unified by a shared commitment to addressing Gender-Based Violence (GBV) within the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse dikgato tsa mo malobeng tsa go dika ditiragalo tsa bosenyi moo Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae e leng lona leo le neng le eteletse kwa pele letsholo leno mo go golegilweng baagi ba kwa nageng ya Pakistani ba le 67 bao ba neng ba leka go tsena ka fa nageng ka mokgwa o o seng mo molaong kwa Boemelafofaneng jwa Difofane tsa Boditšhabatšhaba jwa OR Tambo ka Latshipi wa la bo 13 Phatwe Samiti ya Ngwaga wa 2023 e e ka ga go Fetola Megopolo ya Batho ba Bong jo Botona.

src: The Summit was hosted by HIGHER HEALTH and the Human Science Research Council (HSRC) on behalf of the Department of Higher Education and Training and the Department of Science and Innovation.
tgt: Samiti ya Ngwaga wa 2023 e e ka ga go Fetola Megopolo ya Batho ba Bong jo Botona e e sa tswang go konosediwa e nnile le seabe se se tseneletseng mo bathong ba le 1 500 ba ba neng ba e tsenetse, mme dipuisano tse di tshwerweng di ne di rora jaaka ditau e bile le tshedimosetso e e tlhagileng mo go tsona e ne e le e e bulang matlho mme tseno maitlhomo e ne e le go fetola maitsholo le megopolo ya banna le basimanyana.

src: The aim was to engage the sector leadership, on transforming mentalities and address the root causes of GBEvidence and data suggest that men behavior has been one of the root causes of GBV and the Summit called for action for men and boys towards being part of the solution.
tgt: Jaaka e ne e tshwaretswe kwa Birchwood Hotel kwa tikwatikweng ya OR Tambo Conference Centre, samiti eno e ne e tsenetswe ke Ditlhogo, Batlatsatlhogo, Bagokgo le Baeteledipele ba Makgotlha a Dikhole tsa Katiso le Thuto ya Diatla le ya Setegeniki (di-TVET), Mekgatlho e e Emang Nokeng Baithuti mmogo le e e Eteletseng Baithuti Pele, Batlhankedikhuduthamagabagolo (di-CEO)ba Bothati jwa Lekala la Thuto le Katiso (di-SETA), ba ditheo tse di leng ka fa tlase ga Lefapha la Thuto e Kgolwane, Saense le Boitshimololedi, batlhankedi ba ba kwalang dipholisi, batswasetlhabelo ba ditiragalo tsa go bogisa basadi, bankane ba fatlhosanang, mmogo le batho bao ba dirang diphetogo, mme bano botlhe ba ipopile ngatana nngwe ka mosito o le esi e leng go samagana leditiragalo tsa go bogisa basadi mo Ditheo tsa Thuto tse di Latelang Konosetso ya Dithuto tsa Sekolo le kwa Ditheong tsa Katiso (PSET).

src: The summit asked for the development of more peer educators and champions across all our campuses, to work as change agents towards transforming MENtalities, more men dialogues across all institutions, incorporating gender studies including GBV, gender equality, gender diversity and transforming MENtalities as co-curriculum alongside the main curriculum in the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector.
tgt: Samiti eno e ne e tshwerwe ke setheo sa HIGHER HEALTH mmogo le Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Saense le Batho (HSRC) mo legatong la Lefapha la Ditheo tse Dikgolwane tsa Thuto le Katiso mmogo le Lefapha la Saense le Boitshimololedi.

src: Electricity Cabinet received an update on electricity situation in the country and noted reports of the continued improvement in electricity availability Although the last few days had recorded an increase in the load shedding stages to stage 4, the situation has since improved with the return of units to generation, and Eskom continues to taper down the load shedding stages.
tgt: Maitlhomo e ne e le go buisana le baeteledipele ba lephata leno, go buisana ka ga gore go ka fetolwa jang megopolo e e dirang gore re nne le ditiragalo tsa GBBopaki mmogo le tshedimosetso e e leng teng bobedi bo supa gore banna ke bona ba ba tlhotlhang GBV mme mo Samiting eno go ikuetswe gore go tsewe dikgato gore banna le basimanyana e nne karolo ya ditharabololo.

src: These power outages are caused by system overload due to illegal connections, theft or vandalism of sub-stations and transformers, and vandalism of distribution lines.
tgt: Kwa samiting go ikuetswe gore palo ya bankane ba ba fatlhosanang mmogo le bao ba nang le seabe mo mererong eno e okediwe mo dikhamphaseng tsotlhe, go nna batlisaphetogo mo go fetoleng Megopolo ya Batho ba Bong jo Botona, go oketsa palo ya dipuisano tse di nnang gone mo ditheong tsotlhe tsa thuto, go dira gore mo ditheong tsa thuto tsa PSET go nne le dirutwa tsa segapeletsa tsa go ithuta ka go tsholana ga batho ba bong jo bo farologaneng mmogo le ka GBV, dithuto tsa go lekalekana ga batho ba bong jo bo farologaneng, tsa pharologano ya batho ba bong jo bo farologaneng mmogo le go fetoleng Megopolo ya Batho ba Bong jo Botona.

src: The Minister of Electricity and the Department of COGTA have commenced with a programme to engage with the affected communities to agree on measures that will allow the replacement of damaged infrastructure but linked with the prohibition of illegal connections, community partnerships in the protection if electricity infrastructure, and payment for electricity service.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tshedimosetso go e baya mo dinakong ka ga seemo sa motlakase ka fa nageng mmogo le go nopola dipegelo tse di ka ga maemo a a tsweletseng go tokafala mo go direng gore naga e nne le motlakase.

src: South Africa’s Agreement with the Chinese companies, on recently signed agreements, will play a significant role in introducing electricity infrastructure with self preservation capability.
tgt: Le fa tota matsatsi a le mmalwa a a fetileng re itemogetse maemo a a kwa godimo a bo 4 a motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri, fa e le ga jaanong maemo a tokafetse mo dikarolo tse dingwe tsa phetlho ya motlakase di buseditsweng tirong ya tsona, mme Eskom e tswelela go fokotsa ditiragalo tsa motlakase o tshabetseng ruri.

src: Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.1 Cabinet was briefed about the unconstitutional draft Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.2 The Draft Bill violates the provisions of Schedules 4 and 5 of the Constitution that set out powers and functions including concurrent powers of both the provincial and National executives.
tgt: Kabinete e tsopoletswe gore go na le metse e e senang motlakase ka ntlha ya motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri le go timelwa motlakase.

src: Cabinet has noted that this draft Bill is an attempt to revert back to the Democratic Party’s (forerunner to the Democratic Alliance) preferred federal approach that seeks to undermine a United and inclusive South Africa.4 It is noteworthy that WC draft Bill ignores the exclusion from access to services of the large black communities of Khayelitsha, Gugulethu, Nyanga, Langa, the Cape Flats, Delft, Central Line, amongst others Cabinet has mandated the Ministers of Justice and COGTA to enter into discussions with the Western Cape provincial government in line with the relevant dispute resolution mechanisms as provided for in section 146 of the Constitution and the applicable intergovernmental framework.
tgt: Go timelwa motlakase gone go tlhodiwa ke go imelwa ga didirisiwa tsa tlamelo ya motlakase ka ntlha ya batho ba ba ikgogetseng motlakase go se mo molaong, go senyediwa le go utswediwa megala ya motlakase mo diteišeneng tse di potlana tsa motlakase le mabokoso a motlakase a a leng mo metseng, mmogo le go kgaolwa ga megala ya motlakase.

src: The fund was established to assist minibus taxis, cabs and e-hailing drivers who were financially disadvantaged during the Coronavirus Disease hard lockdowns, in line with stipulated criteria.
tgt: Tona ya Merero ya Motlakase mmogo le Lefapha la Pusoselegae le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA) ba setse ba simolotse ka letsholo la go buisana le baagi gore ba utlwane ka seo se tla diriwang gore mafaratlhatlha a a sentsweng a ntshiwe mme go tsenngwe a mantšhwa mme go tshwanetswe go dumelwanwe gore ga go sa tlhole go tla nna le ditiragalo tsa go ikgogela motlakase go se mo molaong, baagi ba tla tshwanela go sirisana le ditheo tseno mo go tlhokomeleng mafaratlhatlha e bile ba tla tshwanela gape le ke gore ba reke motlakase.

src: Green Paper on the Development of Tourism in South Africa Cabinet approved the publication of the Green Paper on the Development of Tourism in South Africa for public comments.
tgt: Tumelano ya naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya China, e e saenilweng mo malobanyaneng, e tla nna le seabe se se botlhokwa thata mo go nneng le mafaratlhatlha a motlakase a a kgonang go sonaga motlakase.

src: The policy seeks to address the historically institutionalised inequalities and disparities, which follow racial and economic access lines in theatre and dance.2 The policy aims to set a vision and practical policies, strategies, implementation mechanisms and time frames that will result in a sustainable and vibrant theatre and dance sector in all nine provinces, with South African dance and theatre makers representing the country with pride continentally and globally.
tgt: Go botlhokwa go ela tlhoko gore Molaotlhomo ono wa puso ya porofense ya Kapa Bophirima o itlhokomolosa ka bomo maikarabelo a go akaretsa mo ditirelong tsa yona metse e megolo e go nnang bana ba mmala wa sebilo ya kwa Khayelitsha, Gugulethu, Nyanga, Langa, the Cape Flats, Delft, Central Line, gareng ga e mengwe e mentsi.5 Kabinete e romile Tona ya Bosiamisi le ya COGTA go atlhaatlha kgang eno le puso ya porofense ya Kapa Bophirima go rarabolola kgang eno go ya ka dikgato tse di matshwanedi tsa tharabololo ya dikgogakgogano jaaka di tlhagisiwa go ya ka karolo ya bo 146 ya Molaotheo mmogo le leano le le leng gone la go tsamaisa tiro magareng ga ditheo tsa puso.

src: The Commission has noted the ‘rocket and feather’ effect, where prices are quick to rise often in excess of cost increases and slow to fall once cost pressures decline.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go atolosiwa ga paka ya go thusa ka matlole beng ba dithekesi ka paka e nngwe ya dingwa di le Go atolosiwa ga paka eno go tla kgontsha Lefapha la Dipalangwa gore le neelwe nako e e tlhokagalang gore le kgone go thusana le matšhwititšhwiti a beng ba dithekisi ba ba iseng ba neelwe thuso ba ba tla tlamelwang ka matlole a go ba thusa.

src: It has also flagged the concentrated nature of the food and retail markets as a concerning contributing factor.
tgt: Thuso eno e simolotse mo nakong ya fa re ne re le mo pakeng ya dikgatong tsa go sekega nakwana ditiro tsa ka fa nageng ka ntlha ya Bolwetse jwa Mogare wa Corona mme yona e ne e lebeletse go tswa thuso beng ba dithekesi tse dikgolo, tsa dijanaga le tsa e-hailing, mme madi ano a tswa go ya ka lenaneo la bopaki jo bo tshwanetseng go tlhagisiwa ke badiradikopo.

src: The Cabinet has noted the Commission’s recommended measures including market inquiries to address structural features in the market that lead to high food prices and low levels of competition.
tgt: Sekwalwa sa Bofelo sa Tetlelelo ya Tiragatso ya go Ntshetsapele Bojanala ka fa Nageng ya Aforika Borwa Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go phasalatsa Sekwalwa sa Bofelo sa Tetlelelo ya Tiragatso ya go Ntshetsapele Bojanala ka fa Nageng ya Aforika Borwa gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga sona.

src: Cabinet has approved that the Economic Cluster must put in place an action plan on food prices, food secure and access to food.
tgt: Maitlhomo a sekwalwa seno ke go tlhabolola le go ntshetsa pele lephata la bojanala ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa, mmogo le go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di dirang gore lephata la bojanala le retelelwe ke go gola.

src: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Sekwalwa seno se tla ntshetsa pele gape le bojanala mo mafelong a metseselegae le a metsesekateropo ka go rotloetsa gore ditlhagisiwa tse di tswang kwa mafelong ano di babadiwe le go bewa mo pepeneneng.

src: Appointment of Non-Executive members to serve on the Ports Regulator Board for a period of three years.1 Mr Aubrey Ngcobo as the Chairperson.2 Ms Lauriette Lynne Sesoko.3 Adv Derrick Jeffrey Block.4 Ms Thembela Beryl Taboshe.5 Mr Abdul Qadir Chogle.6 Dr Percy Derrick Manzini.7 Ms Princess Mangoma Ms Sizakele Makhanya.9 Ms Ntebaleng Rolland Setlako.10 Ms Marcia Xolisile Mkhari.11 Ms Leanda Marsha Mtshali – re-appointment.
tgt: Maitlhomo a pholisi eno ke go tumola ka moodi tlhokotekatekano le go se tshwarwe ka go tshwana ga baagi e leng selo se se sa bolong go agelelwa mo ditheong tsa rona se se gatang ka mosito o le mongwe le wa tlhaolele le go tswalela mejako ya go iphedisa mo ditheong tsa metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le ya ditheo tsa go ja leoto.2 Maitlhomo a pholisi ke go tlhoma ponelopele le dipholisi tse di ka diragadiwang, go loga maano, go tla ka dikgato tse di tla latelwang go tsenya tirisong maano ano mmogo le go tlhagisa dinako tse ka tsona go tshwanetsweng go bo go garetswe go dira gore lephata la metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le go ja leoto le tswelele go nna teng le go nna le matlhagatlhaga mo diporofenseng tsotlhe di le robongwe tsa naga, mo badiragatsi ba metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le ba go ja leoto ba kgone go ipela mo go emeleng naga ya rona mo kontinenteng le mo lefatsheng ka bophara.

src: Appointment of Non-Executive Directors of South African Maritime Safety Authority (SAMSA) Board for a period of three years.1 Mr Mahesh Fakir – Chairperson.2 Mr Tau Morwe – Deputy Chairperson.3 AdvAurelia Nosipho Sobekwa.4 Dr Natalie Skeepers Ms Nogolide Feziwe Nojozi.6 Mr Sihle NguseUpcoming events.
tgt: Dipegelo tsa go Ela Tlhoko Maemo a Ditlhwatlhwa tsa Dijo tse di Botlhokwa.1 Khomišene e e Okameng Merero ya Dikgaisano tsa Dikgwebo e ntse e etse tlhoko maemo a ditlhwatlhwa tsa dijo tse di botlhokwa go latela gore go nne le ditiragalo tsa go tlhatlosa ditlhwatlhwa ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa godimo e leng ditiragalo tse di simolotseng go iponagatsa fa go ne go nna le Ditiragalo tsa go Emisa Ditiro tsa ka ga Nageng ka Ntlha ya Masetlapelo ka Mopitlwe 20.2 Maitlhomo a go ela tlhoko ditlhwatlhwa tsa dijo ke ka ntlha ya gore ka fa nageng bareki ba dijo ba tshwanetse go kgona go reka dijo tse di botlhokwa tse di rekegang e bile ga di a tshwanela go tlhaela.3 Khomišene e etse tlhoko maemo a a tlhatlogang ka lebelo le le bofefo mo ditlhwatlhwa di tlhatlogetseng ruri ka bonako mme gantsi tlhwatlhwa e di tlhatlogang ka yona e feta eo ba e dirisang fa ba reka dilo tseo ba di rekisang e bile ditlhwatlhwa tse ba rekileng ka tsona fa di fokotsega tseo ba rekisang ka tsona di fokotsega ka bonya.

src: National Police Commemoration Day In honour of our heroes and heroines who passed away in the line of duty, the South African Police Service’s National Commemoration Day will be held at the Union Buildings on Sunday, 3 September 2023.
tgt: Kgwedi ya ngwaoboswa e tla ketekiwa ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Re keteka pharologano ya ditso tsa rona ka fa nageng ya temokerasi ya Aforika Borwa”.

src: The National Flag will be flown at half-mast on the day of the event.
tgt: Jaaka re tla bo re keteka lobebe lwa mefuta e e farologaneng ya ngwaoboswa ya rona, baagi ba rotloediwa go sola mosola Kgwedi ya Ngwaoboswa ka go dira gore setšhaba sa rona e nne seoposengwe.

src: Algemene Vergadering van die Verenigde Nasies (UNGA) Die Kabinet het die toespraak deur President Cyril Ramaphosa by die 78ste UNGA wat van 18 tot 26 September 2023 in New York, Verenigde State van Amerika, gehou is, verwelkom.
tgt: Kopanokakaretso ya Kokoano ya Dinagakopano (UNGA) Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke puo ya ga Moporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa kwa kopanong ya bo 78 ya UNGA e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa New York, kwa Amerika go tloga ka la bo 18 go fitlha ka la bo 26 Lwetse 2023.

src: Die President se welkome toespraak het Suid-Afrika se voorvegtersposisie in die belange en gelyke en sinvolle deelname van die Afrika-kontinent en die globale Suide in die algemeen by die VN en ander multilaterale forums, herbevestig.
tgt: Puo ya ga Moporesitente e e neseditsweng pula ke botlhe e totobaditse maemo a naga ya Aforika Borwa mo go nneng le seabe mo go direng gore kontinente ya Aforika mmogo le dinaga ka kakaretso tse di leng kwa Borwa jwa Lefatshe dikgatlhegelo tsa tsona le go nneng le seabe ga tsona go sekegelwe mosako mo diforamong tsa Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano (UN) mmogo le mo diforamong tse dingwe tsa dinaga tsa mafatshefatshe.

src: Die toespraak het ook Suid-Afrika se vasberadenheid vir die steunmobilisering vir die volgende, herbevestig:
tgt: Puo eno gape e totobaditse le kemo ya naga ya Aforika Borwa mabapi le go bokeletsa kemonokeng mo:

src: hernude toewyding aan multilateralisme, gebaseer op duidelike reëls en deur doeltreffende instansies ondersteun.
tgt: mererong e e ntšhwafaditsweng ya go ema nokeng bosetšhaba, mme seno se tla diriwa go ya ka melao e e tlhamaletseng e e engweng nokeng ke ditheo tse di mosola.
